name: bank impersonation ("move money to a safe account")
text: This is your bank's fraud department. Your account has been compromised. Move your money to a safe account now and read me the code we just sent you. Don't tell anyone at the branch.

name: family emergency ("grandma, it's me")
text: Grandma, it's me. I've been in an accident and I'm in jail. I need bail money right away. Please buy gift cards and send me the numbers. Don't tell Mom and Dad.

name: government or tax threat
text: This is the tax office. There is a warrant for your arrest for unpaid taxes. Pay today with gift cards or a wire transfer to avoid police action.

name: parcel delivery fee text
text: Your parcel is on hold because of an unpaid delivery fee. Pay the small fee at this link today or it will be returned.

name: unpaid toll text
text: You have an unpaid toll balance. Pay now at the link to avoid late fees and suspension of your licence.

name: fake tech support
text: We detected a virus on your computer. Call our support line now and we will connect remotely to fix it. There is a fee to renew your protection.

name: fake refund or account verification
text: Your refund is on hold. Log in and verify your account details within 24 hours or your account will be suspended.

name: prize or lottery win
text: Congratulations, you have won a prize. To claim it, pay the processing fee and confirm your bank details.

name: online romance asking for money
text: My love, I want to come and see you but I am stuck abroad. Please send money for the ticket, I will pay you back. Keep this between us.
